anatomic_site_tumor: From selected prostate cancer patients (PC; n = 3), urine samples prior to radical prostatectomy and resected prostate cancer tissue samples were collected.
material_type: All samples were second morning whole void urine samples from fasting donors.
sex: Mass spectrometry-based proteomic analysis of urinary EV (uEV) in men with benign and malignant prostate disease allowed us to significantly expand the known human uEV proteome with high specificity and identifies a unique biological profile in prostate cancer not uncovered by the analysis of soluble proteins.

disease_state.evidence: Matched urine samples were collected from prostate cancer patients prior to (n = 12) and 3 months after local treatment by radical prostatectomy or intensity-modulated radiation therapy (n = 10).

species.evidence: Tandem mass spectra were searched using the MaxQuant software (version 1.5.2.8) against a database containing both reviewed (SwissProt) and unreviewed (TrEMBL) sequences of homo sapiens, including different isoforms, of UniProtKB release 2018_07.
